assessment_scope: Independent first-pass assessment of the complete proposal against all four requested outcomes, current vision and Constitution, ownership and scope boundaries, and proportionate feasibility evidence. The reviewed engineering subject is the proposal; existing model guidance, catalog strategies, layout and execution sources supplied supporting basis rather than receiving Design or Code Review approval. Recording mode: formal-lifecycle. Automation mode: manual. Resource assembly: PRR1G-recorded-context-gated. This isolated invocation ends after assessment and recording.
independence_basis: The proposal contribution was authored by runtime /root under root-proposal-author. Runtime /root/runtime_audit independently read the complete resulting proposal and its relied-on basis and made no proposal edits. This reviewer previously performed a read-only investigation of current test timing before the proposal existed; that factual support did not author the proposal, and its runtime claims were checked again against the current executor. Separation is by actual authorship and work performed, not merely a role label or fresh turn.
limitations: This is a direction-level assessment only. It does not establish the completeness or adequacy of all model test designs, executable coverage, fixture alignment, implementation correctness, final verification or branch readiness.

The complete coverage/discovery audit, precise runtime accounting contract and delivery estimates remain downstream work. Existing catalog classifications and timing infrastructure establish feasibility, not completion or repository-wide benchmark results.

Approval does not authorize automatic continuation. This review request remains isolated; Design authoring, implementation, publication and external service mutations were not performed or approved by this assessment.
rationale: Challenge — pass: the proposal distinguishes incomplete selection guidance and unassessed coverage from the existence of acceptance sections or passing suites. It explains why the earlier three-package scope does not establish whole-model completion.

Goals — pass: all four requested outcomes remain visible: explicit requirement/scenario selection, test designs for every model responsibility, alignment of actual cases and fixtures, and measured runtime for every executable case. The outcomes do not prescribe a particular schema or runner.

Scope — pass: the current System hierarchy and declared 24 document models establish a concrete baseline, while section-owned responsibilities and parent interactions remain included. Python, native Node, generated cases, inline/file fixtures, helpers and semantic procedures are expressly accounted for. Required realization gaps are included; future operational events retain honest applicability.

Governing principle — pass: sufficient proof for every supported obligation and additional effort for material distinct failures is consistent with correctness, reviewability and protection-preserving maintenance.

Direction — pass: supported outcomes and plausible violations drive scenario choice, independent expectations and fixture strategy. Many-to-many realization avoids per-method quotas; equivalent variants can be grouped while authority, persistence, temporal and recovery failures remain distinguishable. Suite changes follow independent review of the owning designs and established retained or replacement protection.

Feasibility — pass: the single embedded Feasibility section states its assessment, inspected foundation, constraints and absence of a known Design blocker. Shared rules and living-test-design guidance already establish the needed ownership and methods; Release, Skill and Authoring strategy documents expose existing, partial or proposed realization. The amount of remaining proof is explicitly unknown and must be audited before delivery estimates or complete-alignment claims.

Feasibility basis for timing: current execution already attributes elapsed time to native case identities and emits optional broad-smoke JSON. Selected reporting and mode membership confirm that broad-smoke alone is not the complete executable population. Extending these existing components is credible. The proposal expressly limits process-level durations and leaves precise measurement interfaces and boundaries to Design.

Material impact — pass: the broader coverage audit, maintenance of traceability, published-guidance reconciliation, expensive but necessary proof, and truthful failure/skipped/unstarted accounting are disclosed. No compatibility retirement, result caching, historical benchmark service, replacement runner, mandatory universal catalog or failing runtime threshold is selected.

Vision alignment: aligned. The vision-alignment dimension passes because durable test intent, attributable evidence and independent assessment strengthen inspectable, resumable and trustworthy engineering without adding a hosted service or replacing professional judgment.

Downstream authority — pass: detailed behavioral contracts, report interfaces, measurement boundaries and delivery allocation remain with Design and Plan. The proposal does not claim that catalog syntax proves adequacy or that a recorded direction establishes implementation readiness.

Requested decision — pass: the decision concerns the complete direction and preserves all four outcomes through downstream allocation. It expressly distinguishes direction approval from review completion, implementation readiness and completed proof.

Scope-preservation result: preserved. All original goals are in scope, including explicit selection guidance and closure of required realization gaps; necessary guidance/admission/discovery/reporting reconciliation is identified. No requested outcome is silently deferred or hidden behind the earlier pilot.

Specialized gates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false. The broad-scope gate is satisfied by explicit core-to-proposal, same-slice-dependency and separate-implementation-slice treatments with owning destinations. Separate implementation slices remain within the approved direction. Current standing authority exists, no material vision exception is requested, and no trigger ambiguity remains.
summary: The direction is sufficiently valuable, bounded and feasible for subsequent authorized Design work covering complete model test design, aligned proof and useful execution-cost reporting.
